findings.reason: Defined the physical-to-dimensionless flow conjugacy using q(τ₀s)/L and p(τ₀s)/P₀, derived the rescaled force k, and made the coupling-based force estimate explicit.
Defined the dimensionless particle trajectories by the same conjugacy and scaling before applying the finite-N flow and empirical characteristic estimate.
Constructed the torus and Euclidean mollifier kernels explicitly and showed that the class of sets where the probabilities agree is a lambda-system, justifying the pi-lambda step.
Derived monotonicity of the explicit smooth step and radial cutoff used for monotone convergence.
